UI_TF_bug_nocopy: Copying did not work. Open the pinned thread "Bug reports" and write down the versions shown below.
UI_TF_bug_where: Your version info is copied. Open the pinned thread "Bug reports", paste it with Ctrl+V and add what happened.
UI_TF_build_copy: Copy this build as text (occupation and traits)
UI_TF_build_damaged: This build code is damaged (characters that do not belong in it). Copy it again.
UI_TF_build_empty: The clipboard is empty. Copy a build code first.
UI_TF_build_invalid: The clipboard holds no build code
UI_TF_build_mismatch: Trait Facts holds values from game version %1, you are running %2. Numbers that are not read live may be outdated.
UI_TF_build_missing_lead: Everything else was loaded. These mods are not active:
UI_TF_build_missing_title: This build needs mods you do not have
UI_TF_build_newer: This build text needs a newer Trait Facts
UI_TF_build_paste: Load a build from the clipboard; replaces your current choice
UI_TF_build_pasted_unknown: %1 entries could not be read (damaged text or another game version)
UI_TF_build_pasted_unknown_one: 1 entry could not be read (damaged text or another game version)
UI_TF_build_replace: Replace your current traits and occupation with the build from the clipboard?
UI_TF_conflict: %1 is running as well. Both mods write into the same tooltips, so lines appear twice and the numbers disagree. Please turn one of them off.
UI_TF_conflict_description: %1 is running as well and also writes numbers into the trait descriptions. Some effects then appear twice, with different numbers. Please turn one of them off.
UI_TF_conflict_screen: %1 is running as well and replaces the trait selection. Trait Facts adds its lines to the vanilla screen, so you will not see them there.

UI_TF_ext_nodata: %1 traits with no numbers yet; their own descriptions apply

UI_TF_live_seasons: Crops with a known growing season
UI_TF_live_sight_note: added to the Search Radius (3 to 10 tiles from Foraging 0 to 10, never below 3); to spot a single item the game also multiplies the radius by (Foraging level + 1)/10 and a factor for the item's weight, so the gain there is usually smaller, often nothing for light items
UI_TF_note_aimdelay: starting delay when you raise the weapon; what each shot adds is the same for everyone
UI_TF_note_aiming0: at Aiming level 0, calm, gun in full condition
UI_TF_note_aimsteady: while aiming, at Aiming level 0; +6.7%% at Aiming 10
UI_TF_note_autolearnfloor: never below level 1: a recipe that needs level 1 still needs level 1
UI_TF_note_axeswing: axes only; measured with a Firefighter Axe at Axe skill 3; per code a bit less with the Pickaxe and at high Axe skill and Fitness
UI_TF_note_band_athletic: yours while Fitness is 9 or higher
UI_TF_note_band_feeble: yours while Strength is 2 to 4; gone at 5, from 6 the game swaps it for Stout
UI_TF_note_band_fit: yours while Fitness is 6 to 8; from 9 the game swaps it for Athletic
UI_TF_note_band_outofshape: yours while Fitness is 2 to 4; gone at 5, from 6 the game swaps it for Fit
UI_TF_note_band_stout: yours while Strength is 6 to 8; from 9 the game swaps it for Strong
UI_TF_note_band_strong: yours while Strength is 9 or higher
UI_TF_note_band_unfit: yours while Fitness is 0 to 1; from 2 the game swaps it for Out of Shape
UI_TF_note_band_weak: yours while Strength is 0 to 1; from 2 the game swaps it for Weak
UI_TF_note_bandset: set by the game from your starting level
UI_TF_note_blooditems: the bloodier the item, the more
UI_TF_note_bloodstress: 120 blood points weigh as much as an open bite wound
UI_TF_note_buildflat: a fixed 50 time units off every construction: -25%% on walls; in single player furniture and other quick builds (about half of the build menu) become instant; in multiplayer, also when hosting, every build takes the same time and it is -25 to -33%%
UI_TF_note_carp0: at Carpentry level 0, more at higher levels
UI_TF_note_chophit: single player: one hit every 1.0 s instead of 1.25 s; in multiplayer, also when hosting, the server lands a hit every 1.5 s with or without the trait
UI_TF_note_climbalone: alone this changes nothing for a new character without gloves (the same step); only a Fitness Instructor drops one step (25%% failures instead of 20%%)
UI_TF_note_climbbase: climbing score: 2 per Fitness, Strength and Nimble level (new character 20); only whole steps count (1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36); not with the sandbox option Easy Climbing (on in Rising): then every climb succeeds
UI_TF_note_climbburglar: a new Burglar (Nimble 2) without gloves goes from 24 to 28: tall fences fail 20%% of the time instead of 25%%; with ordinary gloves 28 to 32, the same step
UI_TF_note_climbdextrous: alone this changes nothing for a new character without gloves and without a Fitness, Strength or Nimble bonus from the occupation; a Farmer, Firefighter, Lumberjack, Nurse, Police Officer or Rancher goes up one step (20%% failures instead of 25%%)
UI_TF_note_climbgymnast: with its Nimble +1 a new character goes from 20 to 26: tall fences fail 20%% of the time instead of 25%%
UI_TF_note_climbhalved: halves the climbing score before other traits add their points; new character: chance to fail on tall fences from 25%% to 33%%; not with the sandbox option Easy Climbing (on in Rising)
UI_TF_note_climbobese: counted before Clumsy halves the score; you only get it by gaining weight in play; at Fitness 4 or 5 the score is 0: tall fences fail about 94%% of the time, always with a heavy load, and walking no longer routes over them; on sheet ropes you will probably fall when climbing up more than about 3.5 floors in one go; not with the sandbox option Easy Climbing (on in Rising)
UI_TF_note_climbstrengthbase: higher climbs faster, but levels 4 and 5 climb at the same speed (a new character without gloves is at 5)
UI_TF_note_climbup: climbing up only; levels 4 and 5 climb at the same speed, so a new character without gloves loses nothing
UI_TF_note_climbupobese: climbing up only; at Strength 5 without gloves you drop from level 5 to 3 and climb about 56%% slower
UI_TF_note_climbweight: counted before Clumsy halves the score; a new character without gloves with it (Fitness 4) has a score of 3, which fails tall fences every time (25%% without the trait), a game bug; not with the sandbox option Easy Climbing (on in Rising)
UI_TF_note_coldmeter: no dice roll: a hidden meter fills while you are chilled and a cold starts when it is full; once you are no longer chilled it empties within seconds
UI_TF_note_conedeg: 144° to 180° in daylight, fading as it gets darker
UI_TF_note_conenight: on foot: full in darkness, fading as it gets lighter; in vehicles only at dusk (at most about +20°), nothing at night; Eagle Eyed does nothing in vehicles
UI_TF_note_container_less: every container except your inventory, corpses and the floor; rounded down, never below 1
UI_TF_note_container_more: every container except your inventory, corpses and the floor; rounded down, at least 1 more
UI_TF_note_cooking1: at Cooking level 1 or higher and Short Blade 3 or lower, opening with a knife or stone
UI_TF_note_critcap: ranged weapons only; the game keeps crit chance between 10%% and 90%%, so the +10 shrinks or vanishes near those limits (shotguns up close, high Aiming)
UI_TF_note_cutspread_fast: four wound types, from -36%% to -60%%; bleeding, pain and limping scale the same way
UI_TF_note_cutspread_slow: four wound types, from +56%% to +100%%; bleeding, pain and limping scale the same way
UI_TF_note_deadbarricade: not used in 42.20: barricading is a construction now, see Time to build
UI_TF_note_deadcarry: never applies; only your Strength level counts
UI_TF_note_deadcraftwalk: no effect: in 42.20 every recipe stops when you walk, with or without All Thumbs
UI_TF_note_deadforageprof: no effect in 42.20 (game bug): the game looks up the profession by object instead of by name, so only the darkness bonus from traits counts
UI_TF_note_deadgrapple: only checked against a minimum of 0.5 (a grab is refused below it); no trait combination gets that low (lowest: 0.54, Emaciated with Cowardly), so it never changes anything
UI_TF_note_deepstitch: average of the random range; only while the deep wound is bandaged and not stitched: stitching ends this timer, and stitches heal the same with or without the trait; without a bandage it does not heal
UI_TF_note_detectionbase: base 3.5 tiles, without hearing-muffling headgear; helmets and hoods scale the part above 2 tiles (for example x0.75)
UI_TF_note_doorswindows: only when struggling with a window (forcing a locked one from outside, or closing one while someone climbs through) and when hitting a closed door with a weapon; ordinary opening and closing costs no endurance
UI_TF_note_enddelta: when running, sprinting, dragging a corpse, or walking while Very Overloaded or worse
UI_TF_note_fallasleepbase: 0 to 18 without the trait, in an average bed without pain or stress; bed and stress scale both, pain adds over an hour to both, never more than 2 hours; with sleeping pills 0 to 6 either way
UI_TF_note_fallinjurybase: only when a fall injures you: the chance of that is the health the fall costs (more with a fuller inventory, and this trait raises it too); a deep wound also gets likelier; from about three floors a fracture is certain anyway; with the sandbox option Bone Fracture off (as in Rising) it raises only the chance of a deep wound
UI_TF_note_firelightrace: per attempt 50%% to 75%%, so fewer attempts and fewer sticks: roughly 40%% less time until it burns
UI_TF_note_footclumsy: what zombies hear, the sound you hear is unchanged; whole tiles, new character with shoes outdoors: sneaking 4 to 5, walking 7 to 9, running 11 to 13, sprinting 14 to 17; indoors about half
UI_TF_note_footgraceful: what zombies hear, the sound you hear is unchanged; whole tiles, new character with shoes outdoors: sneaking 4 to 3, walking 7 to 5, running 11 to 7, sprinting 14 to 9; indoors about half
UI_TF_note_forcesunday: up to 60%% of top speed; just above that briefly stronger than without the trait, then weaker
UI_TF_note_fracturefall: falls only; in vehicle crashes the trait acts only through the crash damage (x0.8 or x1.2); no fractures at all with the sandbox option Bone Fracture off (as in Rising)
UI_TF_note_gainweight_fast: normally 1000 at weight 80; only above weight 70
UI_TF_note_gainweight_slow: normally 1000 at weight 80; only below weight 90, High Weight starts at 95
UI_TF_note_hearingalarm: a clock you carry or a watch you wear still wakes you; one placed in the world only from 1/4.5 of its range (about 3 tiles for an alarm clock, 1.5 for a watch); the muffled hearing is a separate on/off effect
UI_TF_note_hitexample: firearms; for example from 50%% to 70%%, never above 100%%
UI_TF_note_hitforce: shoves from the front or side only: above a force of 0.4 a zombie staggers back about 2 m, below only a short step; from behind, and with weapon hits, it looks the same either way
UI_TF_note_lungebase: at fences and windows, only with the sandbox option Zombie Lunge (on by default, off in Rising); new character 20, lower with more Fitness and Nimble, never below 5
UI_TF_note_lungehigh: new character (Fitness 4 with it): 17%% instead of 20%%
UI_TF_note_meleeswings: weapon swings only; stomping a downed zombie does full damage
UI_TF_note_mpsleep: in multiplayer only if the server allows sleep; SleepAllowed and SleepNeeded are both off by default
UI_TF_note_mt_aimcalm: per game minute while aiming; stress drops by 1 point as well
UI_TF_note_mt_allrecipes: not the welded metal builds (walls, fences, gates, door and window frames, floor, furniture, stairs); with the option Ingenuitive Limit only a random share (Ingenuitive Limit Amount, 50%% by default)
UI_TF_note_mt_ammoback: plus 1 per level in Aiming and Reloading; only with a partly filled magazine; switched off by unticking the option Prowess: Guns can restore ammo
UI_TF_note_mt_antique: per crate or metal shelf; adjustable with the Antique options
UI_TF_note_mt_asceticcook: and the window before it burns halves; only for food that was in your main inventory (not in a bag) before cooking; set once per item and lost when the game is loaded again, after that only food you pick up for the first time gets it
UI_TF_note_mt_asceticfood: good food now makes you unhappy and stressed, bad food content; packaged food no longer lifts mood, boredom or stress, but still fills you
UI_TF_note_mt_barehands: bare-hand shoves, with nothing in the main hand unless the option Martial Artist Allow Weapon Shoves is on; a standing shove normally does no damage, so this is all of it, a stomp gets it on top; 40%% when the trait's roll hits, less at low endurance; scales with the option Martial Artist Scaling
UI_TF_note_mt_bin: 1 to 3 tries per bin; adjustable with the Vagabond options
UI_TF_note_mt_bladeonly: axes, short and long blades, against zombies; doubled when the trait's roll hits; not with Mundane
UI_TF_note_mt_bleed: doubled at head and neck; overall health changes by only part of it (hand a tenth, head six tenths); only while the wound is not bandaged
UI_TF_note_mt_bluntonly: blunt weapons, against zombies; doubled when the trait's roll hits; not with Mundane
UI_TF_note_mt_bounce: the description says two; 6 of 100 each frame for each zombie past the second, then a 60-frame pause; how often depends on the frame rate; Bouncer options
UI_TF_note_mt_calories: up to 78 kg; from 82 kg a quarter of each gain is taken off instead
UI_TF_note_mt_carrymouse: the mod lowers the base value 8 to 6, and Strength multiplies it: -2 at Strength 0, -3 at Strength 5, -5 at Strength 10; Weight options
UI_TF_note_mt_carrymule: the mod raises the base value 8 to 10 (11 from Strength 5, 12 at Strength 10), and Strength multiplies it: +2 at Strength 0, +5 at Strength 5, +10 at Strength 10; Weight options
UI_TF_note_mt_clothspeed: the 'Run speed modifier' in a clothing tooltip is never applied by the game in this build, so there is nothing to remove there
UI_TF_note_mt_corpse: per corpse, 1 to 3 items; higher with Lucky or Scrounger, lower with Unlucky or Incomprehensive; Grave Robber options
UI_TF_note_mt_critbare: plus 1 per Short Blunt level; option Martial Artist Scaling; not with Mundane
UI_TF_note_mt_critblade: plus 1 per level in Axe, Long Blade and Short Blade; not with Mundane
UI_TF_note_mt_critblunt: plus 1 per level in Long Blunt and Short Blunt; not with Mundane
UI_TF_note_mt_critcrowd: plus 10 per zombie within 2 tiles, 5 within 5, 2 within 10; zombie targets only; not with Mundane
UI_TF_note_mt_critfixed: the game still rolls at least 10 of 100, in melee 3 more per weapon skill level from level 4 on and 5 more from behind, and a close kill from behind on an unaware zombie always crits; from the second hit with each weapon, and again after each load
UI_TF_note_mt_critspear: plus 1 per Spear level; not with Mundane
UI_TF_note_mt_crowbar: crowbars only; it grows with your Long Blunt and Strength levels; option Gordanite Effectiveness; applied when you equip the crowbar, so equip it again after a level-up or after loading
UI_TF_note_mt_crowd: plus 5 per zombie within 2 tiles, 2 within 5 and 1 within 10, with no upper limit (five close zombies: 25.5); the zombie you hit usually counts, so a hit starts at about 5.5; five times as much when the trait's roll hits; any weapon, firearms included, against any character; bare hands only with Martial Artist; with a firearm a normal shot takes off about 45%% of the roll from the front and 67.5%% from behind or the side (shotguns 90%% and 135%%), at any Aiming level
UI_TF_note_mt_deprived: only a key ring; a belt with the Forgiving Deprived option
UI_TF_note_mt_dodge: rolled once per newly injured body part while you are in a hit reaction and a damage event fires: cuts and bites bleed and are rolled, a plain zombie scratch usually only if another wound is bleeding; health already lost stays lost, except for bites; option Evasive Dodge Chance
UI_TF_note_mt_drink: per game hour, at the earliest 24 hours after intoxication last fell below 10; Alcoholic options
UI_TF_note_mt_driver: only while you are the driver, and not with the Driving Skill mod
UI_TF_note_mt_driverfade: only while you are the driver, not with the Driving Skill mod; the mod sets it once per car, so braking lasts until a part first wears or the car is loaded again, top speed until the car is loaded again
UI_TF_note_mt_drop: more with carried weight, running and sprinting; less with Dextrous; sandbox option
UI_TF_note_mt_eatpain: per finished meal, up to 100; eating until you are no longer hungry adds 1.3 per hunger point of the food (2.6 if cooked), and drinks that fill you, such as milk, add some too; it is the head's pain, so your pain slowly climbs by 0.8 of it (20 per meal at the default Injury Severity)
UI_TF_note_mt_fever: rolled once per infection; Fast Healer -5, Slow Healer +5, Lucky -2, Unlucky +2; adjustable with the Super-Immune options
UI_TF_note_mt_firetoggle: switched off by unticking the sandbox option Burned Ward Fire Aversion (on by default)
UI_TF_note_mt_framerate: how often depends on the frame rate
UI_TF_note_mt_fresh: rolled for every spoiled item in the container; with fresh and spoiled copies of the same food it can swap a fresh one instead, and the new copy comes uncooked
UI_TF_note_mt_gear_ammo: a pistol case with 8 boxes of ammunition in different calibers, shotgun shells included
UI_TF_note_mt_gear_camp: a small hiking bag with a tent, fishing rod, line and hooks, a flashlight with battery, matches, a water bottle, jerky, a soda and 3 stones
UI_TF_note_mt_gear_car: a toolbox with a car battery, screwdriver, wrench, lug wrench, tire pump and jack, plus a gas can; the gas can is a sandbox option
UI_TF_note_mt_gear_drinker: a bottle of whiskey; switched off by a sandbox option
UI_TF_note_mt_gear_food: a plastic bag with a can opener and 6 canned vegetables
UI_TF_note_mt_gear_maps: a fanny pack with maps of Muldraugh, Rosewood, Riverside, West Point, March Ridge and Louisville, a pencil and an eraser, plus a digital watch
UI_TF_note_mt_gear_medical: a first aid kit with 4 bandages, disinfectant, alcohol wipes, a suture needle, tweezers, tissues, an adhesive bandage and three kinds of pills; the number of bandages is a sandbox option
UI_TF_note_mt_gear_pack: a hiking bag on your back
UI_TF_note_mt_gear_repair: a toolbox with a screwdriver, saw, hammer, a box of nails and 8 garbage bags
UI_TF_note_mt_gear_smoker: from More Traits: a cigarette pack and a lighter; switched off by a sandbox option
UI_TF_note_mt_gear_tailor: from More Traits: a sewing kit with scissors, a needle and 4 spools of thread
UI_TF_note_mt_gear_weapon: a baseball bat and a hunting knife
UI_TF_note_mt_glass: rolled when a damage event fires (bleeding, burning, falls, weapon or car hits, starving, thirst, sickness): cuts and bites bleed and are rolled, a plain zombie scratch only counts at the next such event; on a hit, twice the health you just lost is taken off again (three times in total); a fracture only if the loss is over 0.33, a scratch if over 0.1; a missed roll carries the loss over to the next roll; 29 of 100 with Lucky, 39 with Unlucky; not while asleep or fast-forwarding
UI_TF_note_mt_gourmandcook: and twice as long before it burns; only for food that was in your main inventory (not in a bag) before cooking; set once per item and lost when the game is loaded again, after that only food you pick up for the first time gets it
UI_TF_note_mt_gourmandfood: cooked and not rotten; unhappiness and boredom from it fall away, thirst halves, and it counts as fresh again
UI_TF_note_mt_gym: Fitness and Strength, only while exercising; Strength gets +15%% while Proteins are above 50 and below 300 and +7%% below -300 (the game applies its protein bonus to the extra XP again); adjustable with the option Gym Goer XP Boost
UI_TF_note_mt_hardy: five charges of 5%% each, drawn below 85%% endurance and paid back from a full bar; option Hardy Endurance
UI_TF_note_mt_immuno: extra roll for each newly injured body part while you are in a hit reaction and a damage event fires: cuts and bites bleed and are rolled, a plain zombie scratch usually only if another wound is bleeding; only while you are not infected yet; never together with Evasive, which takes the wound first; option Immunocompromised Chance
UI_TF_note_mt_improvised: improvised weapons, against zombies; 15%% with a very fragile one, 2.5%% with an improvised spear
UI_TF_note_mt_improvrepair: improvised weapons; only when the hit before cost condition; 76 of 100 with a very fragile one, 1 of 100 with an improvised spear (26 if very fragile)
UI_TF_note_mt_inj_broke: a fractured right lower leg, splinted and bandaged
UI_TF_note_mt_inj_burned: burns on every body part, bandaged
UI_TF_note_mt_inj_injured: up to 4 bandaged wounds on random body parts: scratches, cuts, burns or stitched deep wounds; burns only with the option Injured Burns (on by default)
UI_TF_note_mt_jam: halves only the gun's own value; the share from wear and from low Aiming and Strength stays, and a gun with value 0 never jams anyway; set once per gun and lost when the game is loaded again, after that only a gun you hold for the first time gets it
UI_TF_note_mt_lastwind: below 15 health (25 in multiplayer, also when hosting), or in single player when zombies drag you down, and nearby zombies go down with it; also cures the zombie infection, every time it triggers; recharges after 7 game days, 14 if it cured an infection or stopped a drag-down, 28 if both (option Indefatigable Recharge), even with the option Indefatigable One Use
UI_TF_note_mt_lost: per container, rolled once; on a hit every kind of item in it loses 1 (2 if there are 5 or more of it), and a single item is lost with 6 of 100 (food and drainables 16, weapons 11); option Incomprehensive Chance
UI_TF_note_mt_lowmood: per game hour; a wave raises unhappiness by 25, then the mod lowers it until it is just under 25, so an unhappy character ends the wave happier; no new roll while a wave lasts; 1 of 100 with Lucky, 3 with Unlucky or Self-Destructive, 4 with both
UI_TF_note_mt_luck: critical hits, weapon repair, loot, injuries and cravings; the option Luck Impact only counts in the session the character was created in, after loading the save it is always 100%%
UI_TF_note_mt_lv_axe: Axe +2, Carpentry +1; not shown on this screen
UI_TF_note_mt_lv_firstaid: First Aid +3; not shown on this screen
UI_TF_note_mt_lv_maintenance: Maintenance +2; not shown on this screen
UI_TF_note_mt_lv_shooter: Aiming +2; not shown on this screen
UI_TF_note_mt_lv_sneaky: Sneaking +2, Lightfooted +1; not shown on this screen
UI_TF_note_mt_lv_technician: Electrical +2, Mechanics +1; not shown on this screen
UI_TF_note_mt_lv_terminator: Aiming +3, Reloading +2, Nimble +1; not shown on this screen
UI_TF_note_mt_movedist: walking 25%%, running 50%%, sprinting 75%%; adjustable with the Fast options
UI_TF_note_mt_movedistgimp: walking -67.5%%, running -45%%, sprinting -22.5%%; adjustable with the Gimp options
UI_TF_note_mt_mundaneoff: no extra damage, roll or weapon repair from the three Prowess traits; Action Hero and Martial Artist keep their extra damage; Prowess: Guns is not affected
UI_TF_note_mt_nostiff: switched off by unticking the sandbox option Gym Goer Exercise Fatigue (on by default)
UI_TF_note_mt_poison: once the craving has started and more than 72 hours have passed without alcohol; set to hours without a drink / 5 (14.6 at first), then set again every 12 to 23 hours; Alcoholic options (Nonlethal Alcoholism: always 20)
UI_TF_note_mt_quickrest: per game minute; 5.5%% on the ground, 12%% on furniture, less the more tired you are
UI_TF_note_mt_ramend: 10%% of the bar at Fitness 0 or 1, 1%% at Fitness 10
UI_TF_note_mt_rammartial: with Martial Artist each knocked down zombie also loses 0.1 to 0.6 health, less at low endurance; unarmed only, unless the option Martial Artist Allow Weapon Shoves is on; option Battering Ram + Martial Artist; in multiplayer, also when hosting, you are also invisible to zombies and other players while you sprint without a broken bone
UI_TF_note_mt_repairblade: axes, short and long blades; only when the hit before cost condition; not with Mundane
UI_TF_note_mt_repairblunt: blunt weapons; only when the hit before cost condition; not with Mundane
UI_TF_note_mt_repairgun: firearms; only when the shot actually cost condition
UI_TF_note_mt_repairspear: spears; only when the hit before cost condition; not with Mundane
UI_TF_note_mt_rollcompare: taken off directly, past the game's multipliers: from the front at half your weapon's reach a normal melee hit takes off about 7%% (weapon skill 0) to 27%% (skill 10; 29%% with axes) of that roll, x1.5 from behind or the side; with distance that share goes from 0.3 times at 15%% of your reach to twice at full reach, and critical hits and hits on a zombie on the ground raise only the normal hit
UI_TF_note_mt_scare: per game minute while moving, up to 3 of 100 under full stress; each scare adds 25 panic and 10%% stress, which makes the next one likelier, then 30 minutes of quiet
UI_TF_note_mt_scream: above panic 5; the greater the panic, the wider the sound, up to 25 tiles
UI_TF_note_mt_scrounge: per container, rolled once; on a hit, 2 to 4 of the same item get about as many again (2: +2, 3: +3, 4: +5), 5 or more get 2.6 times as many extra (5: +13), and a single item is copied with 21 of 100 (food and drainables), 16 (weapons) or 11 (anything else); options Scrounger Item Chance and Scrounger Loot Modifier. The option Scrounger Chance has no effect in this version.
UI_TF_note_mt_secondwind: needs low endurance or high fatigue and 3 zombies within 5 tiles; in the current More Traits version it never recharges after the first use
UI_TF_note_mt_selfharm: from unhappiness 25 on, down to 100 minus a third of your unhappiness (half with Depressive)
UI_TF_note_mt_sleepfat: on a scale of 0 to 100: 20 from 60 fatigue, 10 from 20, otherwise 5; you wake as soon as fatigue hits zero
UI_TF_note_mt_spearonly: spears, against zombies; doubled when the trait's roll hits; not with Mundane
UI_TF_note_mt_specxp: every skill outside this specialization, except Fitness and Strength; adjustable with the option Specialization XP Reduction
UI_TF_note_mt_specxp_food: all other skills except Fitness and Strength, plus Tracking, Animal Care and Butchering (More Traits bug); option Specialization XP Reduction
UI_TF_note_mt_stomp: doubled plus 1: +148%% for ordinary shoes, +156%% for sneakers, +140%% for the heaviest boots, +120%% for More Traits' Antique Boots, +200%% for footwraps, +225%% for slippers and flip-flops; barefoot it does nothing; set once per pair and lost when the game is loaded again, after that only a pair you put on for the first time gets it
UI_TF_note_mt_sun: builds up by 1 per game minute outdoors between 8 and 17 (0.5 with an umbrella); an umbrella leaves two thirds of it, indoors a quarter; it is the head's pain, so your pain slowly climbs to 0.8 of it (32 at the default Injury Severity)
UI_TF_note_mt_terminator: while a firearm is in your hands
UI_TF_note_mt_tripskill: with Running 10 and Nimble 10; Graceful less, Clumsy more
UI_TF_note_mt_unwavering: any weapon, firearms included (bare hands only with Martial Artist), against any character; from 75%% endurance down, 60%% fatigue or 20 pain; 150%% from half endurance, 70%% fatigue or 50 pain, 200%% from a quarter, 80%% fatigue or 75 pain; option Unwavering Max Damage Multiplier; with a firearm a normal shot takes off about 45%% of the roll from the front and 67.5%% from behind or the side (shotguns 90%% and 135%%), at any Aiming level
UI_TF_note_mt_worker: option Quick Worker Speed Bonus; on 11 of 100 actions shorter still with Lucky or Dextrous (with both: instant), less short with Unlucky or All Thumbs; reading: x0.375 with Fast Reader, x0.625 with Slow Reader (on top of their own effect); putting a held item back in its belt or holster slot keeps its normal time, only the animation is faster
UI_TF_note_mt_workerslow: option Slow Worker Speed Penalty; on 11 of 100 actions less long with Lucky or Dextrous, longer with Unlucky or All Thumbs; reading: x1.375 with Fast Reader, x1.625 with Slow Reader (on top of their own effect); putting a held item back in its belt or holster slot keeps its normal time, only the animation is slower
UI_TF_note_mt_woundinfect: per wound, up to 10; not while alcohol is on the wound; once one wound reaches 10, the wounds after it in the game's body order (hands first, feet last) stop growing too
UI_TF_note_nightambient: at the default night darkness, about twice as bright
UI_TF_note_nightowlcap: halves the delay up to the 2-hour cap; no effect with sleeping pills
UI_TF_note_noisebase: base 2 tiles; computed, but never used in 42.20, in single player or multiplayer: the only check that reads it is switched off on the server that runs it
UI_TF_note_noisedeaf: base 2 tiles, gone with Deaf; computed, but never used in 42.20, in single player or multiplayer: the only check that reads it is switched off on the server that runs it
UI_TF_note_notbleach: not when bleach is the main fluid, and not for rain-tainted food
UI_TF_note_panicdecay: scale 0 to 100; decays about 2 per second, faster the longer you have survived
UI_TF_note_panicrun: most at Extreme Panic; measured at Running 0 to 1, less with higher Running
UI_TF_note_researchfloor: never below 0: a recipe with research level 1 drops only to 0 (-1 level)
UI_TF_note_reverseforcesunday: up to about 3 km/h; above that the force keeps dropping and reaches 0 at 10 km/h
UI_TF_note_reversenoise: because the engine revs higher; applies to the loud engine bursts, the constant low hum grows less
UI_TF_note_reversespeedsunday: 10 instead of 27 km/h on every car
UI_TF_note_roomsize: the smaller the room, the faster; a vehicle counts as 60 tiles
UI_TF_note_rpmbuildreverse: only in reverse; 7.6 to 18%% more pull there
UI_TF_note_sightfloor: the game never lets the radius drop below 3 tiles: in the Search Radius this costs nothing at Foraging 0 and 0.7 tiles more with each Foraging level until it reaches the full value; to spot an item the game also scales the radius by Foraging level and item weight, so for light items this often costs nothing even at high Foraging
UI_TF_note_spoiledcap: rotten food always poisons you (stale food does not); this is the chance of the heavy dose (2.5 times the light one), at most 100%%: most food is at 50%% or more a day or two after it rots; about +40%% poison overall at a 40%% base; raw meat poisons you the same
UI_TF_note_spoiledonly: rotten food always poisons you (stale food does not); this is the chance of the heavy dose (2.5 times the light one): about -20%% poison overall at a 40%% base; the trait helps less once the food has been rotten longer than it was stale, and for many foods (2 days stale) not at all after 4 days; raw meat poisons you the same
UI_TF_note_sponlyclient: single player only: in multiplayer, also when hosting, the server does not apply it
UI_TF_note_sponlysleep: single player only: in multiplayer, also when hosting, you fall asleep at once and never have nightmares
UI_TF_note_spotted_high: only where a zombie is unsure: in the dark, while sneaking, at the edge of its view or far away; one looking straight at you in daylight spots you either way; with the default New Stealth System, without it +100%%
UI_TF_note_spotted_low: only where a zombie is unsure: in the dark, while sneaking, at the edge of its view or far away; one looking straight at you in daylight spots you either way; with the default New Stealth System, without it -50%%
UI_TF_note_swingonly: per swing; the extra cost when the swing hits is unchanged, so a full hit costs about 8%% more in total
UI_TF_note_taintedall: only when the container holds tainted water: then the whole sip loses its poison, bleach included. Pure bleach still poisons
UI_TF_note_topspeedcap: capped at 122 km/h, so fast cars gain little or nothing; in multiplayer, also when hosting, the server speed limit shrinks the gain (on default servers about half on ordinary cars)
UI_TF_note_topspeedsunday: on most cars; sports and race cars lose about 10%%; in multiplayer, also when hosting, the server speed limit makes the loss smaller (default servers: about -12%%, sports cars about -4%%)
UI_TF_note_treatpanic: also when putting on or taking off a bandage or applying a poultice while the wound bleeds; disinfecting and splinting cause none
UI_TF_note_treebase: exact when walking unclothed; running lowers the value, clothing raises it
UI_TF_note_tripbase: only when vaulting a fence at a run or sprint; base 0 at a run, 10 sprinting, plus exertion (Out of Breath and worse), drunkenness, heavy load and pain, minus your Fitness level, never below 0
UI_TF_note_tripclumsy: new character: 0%% to 5%% at a run, 5%% to 15%% sprinting
UI_TF_note_tripgraceful: new character: no change at a run (0%%), 5%% to 0%% sprinting
UI_TF_note_triphigh: new character (Fitness 4 with it): 6%% at a run and 16%% sprinting instead of 0%% and 5%%
UI_TF_note_triplow: counted twice, an engine bug; you only get it by losing weight in play, so it does not lower your Fitness; at Fitness 5: 25%% at a run and 35%% sprinting, counted once it would be 15%% and 25%% (without the trait 0%% and 5%%)
UI_TF_note_tripveryhigh: you only get it by gaining weight in play, so it does not lower your Fitness; at Fitness 5: 15%% at a run and 25%% sprinting instead of 0%% and 5%%
UI_TF_note_vehhit: also when a car hits you, but only with the sandbox option Player Damage From Vehicle Impact above None (None in every preset)
UI_TF_note_weaponsight: moves the weapon's best aiming range outward: better at long range, slightly worse at the near end (pistol at Aiming 0: from 2 to about 4 tiles)
UI_TF_note_windowforced: forcing a locked window from outside, new character (Strength 5): the character keeps trying until it opens or locks; per attempt 10%% to 5%%
UI_TF_note_zombieinjury: one zombie from the front, unarmed: 11%% becomes 14%%; about +21 to +29%% with weapon skill; from behind only with a skilled weapon; no effect from the side or against three (Rear Vulnerability High, the default; Rising uses Medium)
UI_TF_note_zombieinjury_thin: one zombie from the front, unarmed: 11%% becomes 8%%; about -21 to -26%% with weapon skill; from behind only with a skilled weapon; no effect from the side or against three (Rear Vulnerability High, the default; Rising uses Medium)
UI_TF_opt_bug: Report a bug: copies your version info and shows where to post it
UI_TF_opt_dead: Show values that have no effect
UI_TF_opt_dead_tooltip: Numbers the game code sets but never uses, grey, with the reason. Off: the tooltip leaves them out.
UI_TF_opt_excludes_tooltip: The "Excludes" list in the tooltip: traits you cannot take together with this one. "Also grants" stays either way.
UI_TF_opt_saved: Saved right away. Also under Options, Mods, Trait Facts.
UI_TF_opt_wiki_tooltip: Opens the Trait Facts wiki: the source of every value and how it was checked.
UI_TF_stale: measured, differs from our data; the game may have changed
UI_TF_sum_empty: Pick traits to see what they add up to.
UI_TF_sum_noeffect: None of your traits changes a value in 42.20.
UI_TF_sum_showall_tooltip: Opens the whole overview over the two columns on the left. Esc or Close shuts it.
UI_TF_xp_note_base: against the same skill without a boost
UI_TF_xp_note_passive: Fitness and Strength are always exempt
UI_TF_xp_note_sprint: Running is exempt from the penalty
